last_completed_unit.result: At rust-lang/cargo commit 8814ead110e36ed8fdcf1fdd4009baf82bd78523, the cargo_compile_offline_not_try_update test creates a project depending on not_cached_dep=1.2.5 and immediately runs `cargo check --offline` without publishing or pre-caching that dependency in the test setup. The observed no-matching-package/index error therefore occurs at registry/index resolution before any crate-archive download check. Same-file tests where metadata is known but payload is absent fail at the later download stage instead, so this pinned case is not evidence of a missing crate archive.

last_completed_unit.not_verified_scope: Real crates.io package existence, arbitrary Cargo versions, actual local cache contents outside the harness, end-to-end Cargo execution inside Chat, vendoring behavior, or complete Chat parity were not tested.
